scope: Android shelf only; not the complete F08 gate
rationale: Predeclared before the first measurement: 60 Hz single-frame P95 and two-frame P99 targets; two-second first interaction; 512 MiB sampled process PSS ceiling.
limits: Window callback duration is not physical display presentation.
PSS is sampled about once a second, not a continuous peak.
This lane does not cover reader-body scroll, page/font changes or locate/jump.
Other five target platforms require their own evidence.
frame_budget_scope: All ordinary Window callbacks and each original forward/reverse scroll interval.
